items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And they had Andy Gibson who was a good arranger, he played in the band.

ctx.x: Well we had a good first trumpet player in there called Carl Warrick, we called him ‘Bama. He was a great first trumpet player. And they had Andy Gibson who was a good arranger, he played in the band. And Charlie Shavers….fantastic trumpet player, fantastic. And every time I’d hear a trumpet player, he’d be better than the other. Gee whiz, I was so excited, I don’t know, it was a thrill. You’d go hear Art Tatum up on 132nd street, go across the street to Connie’s Inn to hear Don Redman, go to the Savoy to hear…
Did you get any solo space with the Millinder band?
